chunks: And Zurārah narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"Indeed, Sulaymān عليه السلام performed hajj to the House with the jinn, the humans, the birds, and the winds, and he clothed the House with al-Qabāṭiyy."

key_terms.الْقَبَاطِيَّ: fine Egyptian linen garments used to cover the House
key_terms.حَجَّ: performed hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.سُلَيْمَانَ: Sulaymān, the prophet-king mentioned as performing hajj

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe Sulaymān’s hajj and his honoring of the Kaʿbah?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts that Sulaymān عليه السلام performed hajj to the Sacred House accompanied by the jinn, human beings, birds, and winds under his command. It also notes that he clothed the Kaʿbah with fine Qibṭī linen, highlighting both the antiquity of hajj and the reverence shown to the House by the prophets عليهم السلام.
